connector.name: Prometheus MCP Server by pab1it0
connector.registryDescription: MCP server providing Prometheus metrics access and PromQL query execution for AI assistants
connector.summary: Runs locally from the container image prometheus-mcp-server:1.6.1. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the pab1it0 account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: PROMETHEUS_URL_SSL_VERIFY
env.description: Set to False to disable SSL verification

env.name: PROMETHEUS_DISABLE_LINKS
env.description: Set to True to disable Prometheus UI links in query results (saves context tokens in MCP clients)

env.name: ORG_ID
env.description: Organization ID for multi-tenant Prometheus setups

env.name: PROMETHEUS_CLIENT_CERT
env.description: Path to client certificate file for mutual TLS authentication

env.name: PROMETHEUS_CLIENT_KEY
env.description: Path to client private key file for mutual TLS authentication

env.name: PROMETHEUS_MCP_SERVER_TRANSPORT
env.description: MCP server transport type (stdio, http, or sse)

env.name: PROMETHEUS_MCP_STATELESS_HTTP
env.description: Enable stateless HTTP mode for multi-replica support (default: false)

env.name: PROMETHEUS_CUSTOM_HEADERS
env.description: Custom headers as JSON string to include in Prometheus requests
